steps.note: An eight second recording at Fit: the whole of it across the width, and nothing after its last frame

One press of minus from Fit opens the ruler out to sixteen seconds: the recording takes the left half of the width and the right half is empty room after the last clip, the place a new clip is dropped. The ruler keeps counting past 0:08
Fit puts the recording back across the whole width in one press, from the room as from anywhere else
